parent_summary: Most of what Llamie liked is about watching careful work: things made by hand, machines running smoothly and the hidden workings of big places. A little over half has real learning in it. One video leans hard on buying pressure and chance-based rewards, and it is worth a conversation.

themes.name: Making things by hand, carefully
themes.insight: Llamie is drawn to slow, precise making, whether it is noodles, a jar garden or a restored knife. The pull is watching a patient process become something finished.
themes.reasoning: The subjects are food, plants and tools, but each video shows one person building something step by step with close-up care.
evidence: The cook trims each noodle to the same length
Every plant is placed with tweezers
The restorer checks the edge against a ruler
themes.growth_direction: Could grow into cooking, gardening or model making.

themes.name: Peeking behind the scenes
themes.insight: Llamie likes seeing how a familiar place or system works underneath.
themes.reasoning: A theme park and an airport look nothing alike, but both videos open up a hidden system and explain its logic.
evidence: An operator explains what each colour on the screen means
An animation slows a diverter down to show how it works
themes.growth_direction: Could grow into systems design or engineering.

themes.name: Machines working beautifully
themes.insight: Llamie enjoys machines that do a job smoothly, from big cleanup robots to repeating factory loops.
themes.reasoning: One video explains a machine and one just shows it, but both are about smooth, repeatable motion.
evidence: A diagram follows one bottle through the cleanup machine
Each factory clip loops a single motion
themes.growth_direction: Could grow into robotics or mechanical design.

themes.name: Chasing the rarest find
themes.insight: Llamie is pulled by rarity: which item is scarcest and what it is worth.
themes.reasoning: A mystery box video and a card tier list both turn on ranking things by how rare they are.
evidence: Each reveal is built up before the item is shown
Cards are placed in tiers by how few exist
themes.growth_direction: Mostly something to watch, though it could open a talk about value and odds.
